$comment: Affiliate registry — copy to affiliates.json (or point AFFILIATE_REGISTRY at it) to onboard affiliates/tenants. Each affiliate maps to one or more subscriptions, optionally in its own tenant. Omit tenant_id to use the signed-in tenant. billing_account enables MACC; github_orgs enables GitHub Copilot seats. Delete this file / leave no registry to auto-discover every subscription the signed-in identity can read.
